# Unipheas — AI engineering and automation consulting

> Brian Phillips helps businesses establish the tools, AI workflows, engineering
> practices, and knowledge to develop, release, and maintain their own products.

Unipheas is Brian's independent consulting practice. Clients work directly with
him. He has more than 15 years across full-stack development, mobile development,
and software systems. Mobile is a specialty supporting the broader offer.

## Engagements

For CTOs, technical founders, and enterprise engineering teams investing in AI development infrastructure.

- Assessment and architecture: delivery baseline, target architecture, prioritized roadmap.
- Implementation: agent orchestration, repository context, isolated environments, automated testing, CI/CD, and human review.
- Ongoing engineering partnership: agreed delivery capacity, technical direction, workflow maintenance, and measured improvement.

Scope, fees, success measures, and responsibilities are agreed before work begins. Client accounts and code remain under client control. Examples are illustrative, not client results. No guaranteed performance or unattended production operation is promised.
